english.title: Fail to notify loss / damage / theft of driver disqualification card / national driver card or NVT Certificate

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Vehicle Drivers Certificates of Professional Competence Regulations 2007

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been issued with

(A)_[a driver disqualification card]_
(B)_[a national driver qualification card]_
(C)_[an NVT certificate]_

which was damaged, lost or stolen, failed to notify the competent authority in writing of that damage, loss or theft and provide such information or documents concerning the damage, loss or theft as the competent authority required in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 8B(1), (5) and (6) of the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007.

english.notes: This offence applies from the 3rd December 2024 due to changes made by SI 2024/1160 to the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007, widening the remit of the offence.
